  ```
    --splits 8 \
    --group <group-number> \
    --durations=10 \
    -n auto \
    --maxfail=3
  ```
  - Flags explained:
    - `--block-network`: prevent network access during tests
    - `--timeout=30`: 30 seconds timeout per test
    - `-vv`: very verbose pytest output
    - `--splits 8` and `--group <group-number>`: split tests into 8 groups, run only one group at a time
    - `--durations=10`: show slowest 10 tests durations
    - `-n auto`: run tests in parallel across available CPUs via pytest-xdist
    - `--maxfail=3`: stop after 3 failures
- This setup allows running subsets of tests in parallel groups, facilitating distributed test runs for efficiency.
